agent_answered.text: "The comparison I described supports easier release after conditioning; it does not establish stable working capacity across repeated cycles. I cannot tell from the evidence in this thread whether the patent reports a separate cycling test, so I would leave that question open rather than turn the temperature curves into a durability claim. I would compare three runs: dry feed, initi ... e is an ongoing operating requirement, not a one-time treatment. And more recovered CO₂ per day still needs the cycle-time measurement; more complete release alone does not establish that." [2442d66c]
